name: @restor/courier-mobile
description: RESTOR courier app — jobs, delivery flow, wallet (TZ §23-§26).
comment:restorDeps: The @restor/* packages use `file:` links rather than workspace ranges. This app is deliberately NOT an npm workspace — Expo resolves its own native modules and hoisting breaks that linking — so a `*` range would send npm looking for them on the public registry. Run `npm run build:packages` at the repo root before installing: the links point at each package's dist/.
